Add education columns to an existing oda data frame

Source: R/add_cols_education.R
add_cols_education.Rd

This function takes an existing oda data frame as input and adds education columns. The function returns the oda data frame with the following additional columns for education:

education_nok

Numeric variable of total disbursed education oda (earmarked and imputed multilateral).

education_tag

Logical variable to identify education activities, meaning earmarked ODA for DAC sectors of long term and emergency aid and imputed multilateral ODA for education (positive imputed multilateral education shares)

education_oda_channel

Categorical variable to separate earmarked oda to education from imputed multilateral oda to education.

education_oda_channel2

Categorical variable to separate earmarked humanitarian oda to education, long term oda to education, and imputed multilateral to education.

Usage

add_cols_education(df_oda)

Arguments

df_oda

A oda data frame, which must already be loaded into the environment.

Value

A oda data frame with additional education columns.

Details

## Important: Before running this function, you must have already loaded the oda data frame by using noradstats::read_oda().

Examples

# Load the oda data
df_oda <- read_oda()
#> duckdb keeps downloaded extensions and secrets in a temporary directory:
#> ℹ /tmp/RtmpIrjQUj/duckdb
#> This is removed when the R session ends.

#> ℹ See ?duckdb_storage for details and alternatives.

#> ℹ Context: rapi_startup

# Add education column to the df_oda data
df_oda_education <- add_cols_education(df_oda)
